question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, and ACH bank transfers for annual plans. Cryptocurrency payments are available for Enterprise customers.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days within the continental US. Express shipping (2-3 days) and overnight options are available at checkout. International shipping times vary by destination.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all purchases. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team for a full refund. No questions asked. Refunds typically process within 5-10 business days.

question: Do you offer free trials?
answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time during or after your trial.

question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately and you'll be charged a prorated amount. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

question: Is training available?
answer: Yes! We provide free onboarding training for all new customers. Enterprise customers get dedicated training sessions and ongoing support. We also have a comprehensive knowledge base and video tutorials.

question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
answer: Your data remains accessible for 90 days after cancellation. You can export everything during this time. After 90 days, data is permanently deleted from our servers in accordance with our privacy policy.

question: Do you have an API?
answer: Yes, we provide a comprehensive REST API with all plans. API documentation is available at docs.example.com/api. Rate limits vary by plan: Starter (1000 requests/day), Professional (10,000/day), Enterprise (unlimited).

question: Can I use this for commercial purposes?
answer: Absolutely! All our plans include full commercial usage rights. You can use our service for client work, resale, or any business application without additional licensing fees.

question: What browsers are supported?
answer: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported. For the best experience, we recommend Chrome or Firefox with JavaScript enabled.
